_comment: The identities the Qwen lane is pinned to, each recorded with the source commit it was built from rather than on its own. A digest alone cannot prove parity with the code it is supposed to describe — the first gateway image was built ten minutes before the transport was corrected and nothing could tell. Nothing here attests the loaded runtime: that is Stage 3's job, from the GPU, and until it happens the output budgets remain candidate measurements and qwen_overlay stays off.

model.commit_marker: COMMITTED.json written last, after every artifact and the manifest

serving_image.bundled_cuda_runtime: nvidia-*-cu12 12.8.x on a CUDA 12.4 base image. The wheel ships its own runtime, so this is expected — and it is exactly what the Stage 3 load attestation must confirm against the host driver rather than assume.

superseded.why: Its serve.py answered /ping 200 before the model was loaded, built guided decoding from a schema the gateway never sent, and prompted with the bare request JSON — no chat template, so enable_thinking was read by nothing.

not_yet_true: No GPU endpoint exists. Service quota L-B0729CB4 (ml.g6e.xlarge for endpoint usage) reads 0, request for 2 still PENDING.
The loaded runtime is unattested; no release_manifests row names these digests.
output_contract.tokenizer_manifest_sha256 is still 'required_from_pinned_deployment_not_yet_measured', deliberately: it must be regenerated from what the GPU actually loads.

The Step 5 application bridge is unbuilt. overlay.extract_mentions raises in evaluation/shadow, and 0241 asserts semantic_worker cannot execute record_model_invocation — only semantic_model_worker may. Which identity records an invocation is an open design decision, not a missing function.
The prompt few-shots are compiled and carried but not yet selected by the retrieval policy; the model is sent role, rules and a worked example.
qwen_overlay is off and no invocation has ever been recorded.

gateway_image.verified: The running function reports this contract's model_revision and gateway_revision, with model_lane_mode off and no deployment loaded.

superseded.why: Its transport read request_id from the top level while the envelope carries it under input, so every real invocation refused contract_mismatch before reaching SageMaker.
